cases.name: incoming-write-live-owner
cases.source:
def outer():
 value=1
 def write(x):
  nonlocal value
  value=x
  return value
 print(value,write(7),value)
 value=11
 print(write(13),value)
 return write
write=outer()
print(write(17))

cases.name: incoming-write-owner-locals
cases.source:
def outer():
 value=[]
 def write(x):
  nonlocal value
  value=x
  return locals()['value']
 saved=[]
 print(write(saved) is saved,value is saved,locals()['value'] is saved)
 return write
write=outer()
other=[]
print(write(other) is other)

cases.name: incoming-write-after-owner-deletion
cases.source:
def outer():
 value=1
 def write(x):
  nonlocal value
  value=x
 def read():return value
 del value
 try:read()
 except NameError:print('missing')
 write(7)
 print(value,read())
 del value
 return write,read
write,read=outer()
write(19)
print(read())

cases.name: incoming-write-transitive-shadow
cases.source:
value=100
def outer():
 value=1
 def middle():
  nonlocal value
  def write(x):
   nonlocal value
   value=x
   return value
  return write
 write=middle()
 print(write(7),value)
 return write
print(outer()(11),value)

cases.name: incoming-write-comprehension-binding
cases.source:
def outer():
 value=0
 def write(items):
  nonlocal value
  result=[(value:=item) for item in items]
  return result,value
 print(write([3,8]),value)
 return write
print(outer()([5,9]))

cases.name: incoming-write-class-cell
cases.source:
class C:
 def write(self,new):
  nonlocal __class__
  __class__=new
  return __class__
 def read(self):return __class__
instance=C()
print(instance.write(int).__name__,instance.read().__name__)

cases.name: incoming-write-class-body-owner
cases.source:
def outer():
 value=1
 def write(x):
  nonlocal value
  value=x
 write(7)
 class C:
  result=value
 print(value,C.result)
 return write,C
write,C=outer()
print(write(11),C.result)
